title: A wave breaks on a beach around a pier
note: Demonstration geometry: a solitary wave 0.12 m high on 0.25 m of water (H/d = 0.48) meets a 1 in 8 beach and a cylindrical pier. The initial wave is the Boussinesq solitary wave; see docs/lab/water.md for what is verified.

water.source: Incropera, DeWitt, Bergman and Lavine, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 6th ed. (2007), table A.6 (saturated water), 300 K; typed from the table, not re-checked against a copy in this session
